name: Anchored IQL with pessimistic online critic
tagline: IQL during offline; on going online, freezes the offline actor and twin critic and uses them for a pessimistic critic target, a Q-overshoot penalty, and a drift-weighted policy anchor.
formula: $$ \text{V (always)}: \; \mathcal{L}_V = \mathbb{E}[\,L_2^\tau(Q^{\text{tg}}(s,a) - V(s))\,],\;\; \tau = 0.7 $$ $$ \text{Q (offline)}: \; y = r + \gamma(1 - d)\,V(s') $$ $$ \text{Q (online)}: \; y = \min\!\big(y_{\text{Bell}},\; m\,y_{\text{off}} + (1-m)\,y_{\text{Bell}}\big),\quad y_{\text{off}} = r + \gamma(1-d)\min_k Q^{\text{off}}_k(s', \pi(s')) $$ $$ \mathcal{L}_Q\,{\mathrel{+}{=}}\;\lambda_{\text{ovr}}\,\mathbb E[\,(\min_k Q_k(s,a) - \min_k Q^{\text{off}}_k(s,a))_+\,] $$ $$ \mathcal{L}_\pi = -\mathbb E[\,e^{\beta(Q-V)}\,\log\pi(a|s)\,] + c_a\,\mathbb E[\,e^{-\kappa\|\pi(s) - \pi^{\text{anchor}}(s)\|^2}\,(-\log\pi(a|s))\,] $$

key_hyperparams.name: pessimism_mix m
key_hyperparams.role: weight of frozen-offline critic in online target

init_recovers: Plain IQL during offline phase (anchor and pessimism inactive)
diff_from_baseline: Versus the iql baseline, the offline phase is identical IQL but on entering online: (1) the critic target is the min of the standard Bellman target and a (frozen-offline-critic)-anchored bootstrap, (2) a relu(Q_cur - Q_offline) penalty discourages Q overshoot, (3) the actor adds a drift-weighted BC term against a frozen offline policy snapshot; awac/spot-style support constraints are not used.
